name: Pitolisant
summary: Pitolisant, sold under the brand name Wakix among others, is a medication used for the treatment of excessive daytime sleepiness in adults with narcolepsy. It is an inverse agonist of the histamine H3 receptor.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) designated it a first-in-class medication. Pitolisant enhances the activity of histaminergic neurons in the brain that function to improve a person's wakefulness.

pharmacology.text: Pitolisant is an inverse agonist of the histamine H3 autoreceptor. The H3 autoreceptors regulate histaminergic activity in the central nervous system (and to a lesser extent, the peripheral nervous system) by inhibiting histamine synthesis and release upon binding to endogenous histamine.

uses.text: Pitolisant is indicated in adults for the treatment of narcolepsy. Narcolepsy is a chronic sleep disorder that causes overwhelming daytime drowsiness. Pitolisant is also indicated to improve alertness and reduce excessive daytime sleepiness in adults with obstructive sleep apnea.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects include difficulty sleeping, nausea, and feeling worried.

summaryZh: 替洛利生（英語：Pitolisant），商品名鏵可思等，是一種治療發作性睡病成人白天嗜睡的藥物，它是一種組胺3受體拮抗劑/反激動劑，是同類藥物中第一種上市的藥物。它可增強大腦中組胺能神經元的活動，從而提高人的清醒度；其副作用包括睡眠困難、噁心、焦慮等。
summaryZhHans: 替洛利生（英语：Pitolisant），商品名铧可思等，是一种治疗发作性睡病成人白天嗜睡的药物，它是一种组胺3受体拮抗剂/反激动剂，是同类药物中第一种上市的药物。它可增强大脑中组胺能神经元的活动，从而提高人的清醒度；其副作用包括睡眠困难、恶心、焦虑等。

fact.en: Pitolisant was the first drug of its kind to reach patients. It grew out of the discovery of the histamine H3 receptor in 1983 by Jean-Charles Schwartz and colleagues in France.
fact.zh: 替洛利生是同類藥物中第一個用於病人的。它源自 1983 年法國的 Jean-Charles Schwartz 及其同事對組織胺 H3 受體的發現。
